title: GARFIELD-AF
formula:
Mortality, stroke, and bleeding risks at 6 months, 1 year, and 2 years are calculated by the following:

**Risk, %** = [1 – (baseline survival)^exp(x)^]*100

Baseline survivals are as follows:

| | 6 months | 1 year | 2 years |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| All-cause mortality | 0.9879 | 0.9791 | 0.9625 |
| Ischemic stroke/systemic embolism | 0.9956 | 0.9925 | 0.9876 |
| Major bleeding | 0.9969 | 0.9947 | 0.9917 |

x is calculated by the following:

**All-cause mortality x** = -0.306202287*female + 0.693789082*(heart failure) + 0.306120964*(vascular disease) + 0.26585298*(prior stroke) + 0.385407386*(history of bleeding) + 0.280133213*(diabetes) + 0.377903886*(moderate-to-severe CKD) + 0.489453313*(dementia) + 0.345481149*(current smoker) – 0.414591263*(OAC treatment: NOAC) – 0.18593561*(OAC treatment: VKA) + 0.157023564*(ethnicity: Hispanic Latino) – 0.609609055*(ethnicity: Asian) + 0.375675102*(ethnicity: Black/mixed/other) + 0.031050027*(age – 65)*(age≤65) + 0.064594824*(age – 65)*(age >65) – 0.021535182*(weight, kg – 75)*(weight, kg ​​≤75) + 0.007678035*(pulse – 120)*(pulse≤120) – 0.019304333*(diastolic blood pressure – 80)*(diastolic blood pressure≤80)

**Ischemic stroke/systemic embolism x** = 0.233182644*(heart failure) + 0.197919709*(vascular disease) + 0.800863063*(prior stroke) + 0.29883967*(history of bleeding) + 0.211995445*(diabetes) + 0.349516938*(moderate-to-severe CKD) + 0.513221391*(dementia) + 0.478831506*(current smoker) – 0.572199357*(OAC treatment: NOAC) – 0.352373263*(OAC treatment: VKA) + 0.039138147*(age – 65) + 0.01590016*(diastolic blood pressure – 80)*(diastolic blood pressure >80)

**Major bleeding x** = 0.168950627*(vascular disease) + 0.782237771*(history of bleeding) + 0.316245771*(carotid occlusive disease) + 0.498686574*(moderate-to-severe CKD) + 0.24232543*(OAC treatment: NOAC) + 0.609713354*(OAC treatment: VKA) + 0.236620846*(antiplatelet treatment) + 0.176898047*diabetes + 0.043476276*(age – 65) + 0.004167103*(pulse – 120)

how_to_use.why:
- Calculates the risk of mortality, ischemic stroke, and major bleeding (including hemorrhagic stroke).
- Calculates the risk at 6 months, 1 year, and 2 years after diagnosis of AF.
- Risk can be calculated without anticoagulation, with an oral novel oral anticoagulant (NOAC), or with a vitamin K antagonist (VKA).
- The GARFIELD-AF Registry is the largest prospective registry of patients with newly diagnosed atrial fibrillation.
how_to_use.when: Utilisation chez les patients présentant une fibrillation atriale (AF) nouvellement diagnostiquée.
how_to_use.pearls:
- Cet outil comprend 16 champs de saisie ainsi que la possibilité de visualiser le risque selon le type de traitement choisi. Ce score a été dérivé du registre GARFIELD-AF.
- Il a été validé en externe dans le registre ORBIT-AF.

next_steps.advice:
- Utilisez le champ OAC Treatment pour sélectionner le traitement pour lequel vous souhaitez afficher les calculs de risque spécifiques à 6 mois, 1 an et 2 ans après le diagnostic.
- Le risque de mortalité, d’AVC ischémique et d’hémorragie majeure (y compris l’AVC hémorragique) est affiché pour chaque période.
- Cela peut être utilisé dans le cadre d’un plan de prise en charge global pour les patients ayant une fibrillation atriale nouvellement diagnostiquée.

short_description: Risque de mortalité, d’AVC et de saignement.
medium_description: Predicts mortalité, AVC, et saignement dans patients w/ et w/out anticoagulation.
